name: Seer
actingPrinciples: Act as a real fortune-teller rather than merely possessing divination powers.
Respect fate and avoid extracting excessive personal benefit from divination.
Do not treat divination as omnipotent; avoid recklessly divining matters involving high-level existences.
milestones: Chooses the Seer pathway and drinks the potion.
Uses the Divination Club as a practical acting environment.
Gradually summarizes his own Seer principles and recognizes the acting method.
Fully digests the potion before preparing for Clown.

source.note: Chapter 31 contains the potion event; later passages explicitly describe Klein's Seer principles and full digestion.

name: Clown
abilities: Further enhancement of prior Seer abilities
milestones: Advances during the late Tingen period.
Uses the Sequence's improved physical control during the Volume 1 climax.
Carries Clown-stage abilities into early Backlund investigations.
Confirms the potion is fully digested before collecting Magician ingredients.

source.note: Promotion and digestion are anchored; the exact consolidated Clown acting-principle list is still being located in the EPUB and is intentionally left blank for now.

name: Magician
actingPrinciples: Challenge the impossible, even if the final outcome is only an illusion.
milestones: Finishes gathering the ingredients immediately before advancement.
Begins experimenting with performances and audience feedback to accelerate digestion.
Concludes the five principal Magician rules.
Uses the resulting escape and deception toolkit throughout Sherlock-era investigations.

source.note: Chapter 296 is the Magician chapter; later text explicitly lists all five Magician principles and describes Paper Figurine Substitute, Flame Controlling and Illusion Creation.

name: Faceless
actingPrinciples: You can disguise yourself as anyone, but you are ultimately yourself.
Get into character while remaining detached from the role.
Overcome aversion when acting, but do not become over-immersed.
Disguise yourself as another person and obtain genuine feedback from others.
milestones: Advances in Backlund.
Uses multiple identities and lived experiences to refine acting.
Learns that preserving the self is the core defense against losing control.
Creates Gehrman Sparrow as a deliberately distinct sea-going persona.

source.note: The EPUB explicitly states the core Faceless principle of remaining yourself and later summarizes getting into character, staying detached and obtaining feedback while disguised.

name: Marionettist
ritual: Drink the potion while hearing a mermaid sing.
actingPrinciples: Avoid personally doing what can be delegated to a marionette when the situation does not require direct action.
Give each marionette a distinct identity and setting so it behaves as a believable individual.
abilities: Initial control of a target through Spirit Body Threads
Control marionettes while retaining their original Beyonder powers
milestones: Learns the advancement ritual long before he can use it.
Prepares the potion and sails to where mermaids can be found.
Drinks the potion while mermaids sing.
Chapter 665 immediately demonstrates Spirit Body Threads.
Refines his acting by developing unique marionette identities.

source.note: The ritual, potion ingestion, Spirit Body Thread mechanics and the principle of giving marionettes unique identities are all explicit in the EPUB.

name: Bizarro Sorcerer
milestones: Crosses into demigod level.
Marks a qualitative change in his Seer-pathway toolkit.
Becomes capable of participating directly in high-sequence conflicts.

source.note: Promotion is directly anchored. Acting principles and a curated ability list will only be added after direct chapter-level verification.

name: Scholar of Yore
actingPrinciples: Pursue and reconstruct real ancient history rather than collecting disconnected trivia.
Approach history as a scholar: connect events, understand causes and recover the actual process behind the past.
milestones: Chooses an isolated Berserk Sea island for advancement.
Uses genuine ancient historical records as supplementary ingredients.
Links potion digestion to uncovering and reconstructing hidden history.
Fully digests the potion before preparing to become a Miracle Invoker.

source.note: The EPUB states the advancement location and later explicitly ties Scholar of Yore digestion to understanding and reconstructing ancient history and using the Historical Void.

name: Miracle Invoker
actingPrinciples: Accumulate wishes by satisfying other people's wishes.
Create real miracles step by step rather than treating wishes as unlimited power.
Walk the real world as a wandering magician so people can witness miracles and have their wishes fulfilled.
abilities: Further qualitative enhancement of historical abilities
milestones: Advances to Sequence 2 angel level.
Discovers that Wishes require accumulated fulfilled wishes rather than unrestricted use.
Builds the Merlin Hermes identity around satisfying wishes in the real world.
By Chapter 1316, states that he has concluded the Miracle Invoker acting principles.

source.note: Chapters 1268–1269 explicitly describe the potion and the Wishes mechanism; Chapter 1316 states that Klein has concluded the acting principles.

name: Attendant of Mysteries
milestones: Advances at the King of Angels level.
During ingestion, his body and Worms of Spirit begin fusing into the spirit world.
The remaining progression becomes inseparable from resisting the awakening of Celestial Worthy and preparing for The Fool apotheosis.

source.note: Potion ingestion and transformation are explicit. Acting principles and ability summaries remain pending direct source extraction.

name: The Fool
milestones: The Fool identity and Klein's personal Sequence progression finally converge.
The apotheosis conflict is directly contested by Amon.
The final battle becomes inseparable from control of the Lord of Mysteries authorities and Sefirah Castle.

source.note: Chapter 1380 contains the contested Fool potion/apotheosis event. A later pass will break this climax into finer chapter-level milestones.
